eyebrow: FROM HER IPHONE TO YOUR COMPUTER
title:
Your moments.
Exactly as recorded.
intro: Original photos and videos, straight between you. No compression, no accounts, and no cloud storage for your files.
phoneHint: Send photos and videos from Files
inviteHint: Send the invitation through a private chat. It expires in 15 minutes and only works for this connection.
remoteHint: Uses a Google STUN service to find a connection. It sees your IP and request time, but never receives your files.
keepTab: Keep this tab open. Never forward the invitation to someone else.
answerHint: She will open the invitation and send a reply to connect the devices.
openInviteHint: Use Safari. If you did not open the link directly, paste it here.
sendAnswer: Send it through the same private chat and wait for him to paste it. Keep Safari open.
verify: Compare this code through your private chat
verifyHint: It must match on both devices.
iphoneHint: Export the original from Photos to Files before sending. This app preserves the exact file you select; it cannot undo an earlier iOS conversion.
selectHint: Original MOV, MP4, HEIC, JPG and more · up to 20 GiB per file
receiveHint: When she chooses a file it will appear here. You decide whether to receive it and where to save it.
accept: Accept and choose where to save
online: Both must keep the screen on and the tab open.
privacyTitle: Your files go from one device to the other.
privacyBody: This website does not store photos, videos, accounts, or passwords. You and your partner approve the connection. Files retain their metadata, including location if present.
limitsBody: The website and its providers can see visits and IP addresses; a direct connection reveals your IP to the other device. The invitation link is a secret. Some networks cannot connect without a relay server: try another network or the same Wi-Fi. No storage while the computer is off, and no resume after closing a tab.
devicePrivacy: Encryption cannot protect a compromised device or files after downloading. Saved files remain on your disk when the session ends. Use a private chat for invitations and protect your GitHub account with two-factor authentication.
footer: Built to share originals. Not to collect your data.
streamStorage: Chrome or Edge saves directly to disk without keeping the whole video in memory.
memoryStorage: This browser receives into memory: up to 256 MiB awaiting download. Use Chrome or Edge on the computer for large videos.
copied: Copied. Share it only through your private chat.
copyManual: The text is selected. Copy it manually and share it through your private chat.
closed: The session and temporary files in memory were cleared. Files already saved to disk remain there.
rejected: The file was rejected. Its contents were not sent.
cancelled: You cancelled saving. The file was not received.
localPreview: This address only works on this computer. Publish the site folder to GitHub Pages with HTTPS to open invitations on the iPhone.
answerInComputer: Paste this reply into the original computer tab where you created the invitation.
badCode: The invitation or reply does not belong to this session. Copy the entire link and check that it came from your partner.
expired: The invitation expired or is invalid. Create a new one and keep the tab open.
badFile: Select a supported photo or video, larger than zero and up to 20 GiB. Executables and web pages are not accepted.
protocol: The connection sent unexpected data. It was closed to protect your files. Create a new invitation.
timeout: The transfer stopped making progress. Check both devices, keep Safari in the foreground, and reconnect.
disconnected: The connection was interrupted. Keep Safari open and the screen on. If it does not recover, create a new invitation.
memoryLimit: This browser cannot save that file with the available memory. Download earlier files and use Chrome or Edge on the computer for large videos.
integrity: File verification failed. It was not saved as a completed transfer. Send it again.
network: The connection between your networks failed. On different networks, configure an encrypted relay on the computer and create a new invitation. You can also try another network, or the same Wi-Fi if together.
unavailable: The operation could not be completed. Use current Safari on iPhone and current Chrome or Edge on the computer, over HTTPS or localhost.
disk: Could not save to disk. Check permissions and free space. The file was not accepted.
relayTitle: If your networks cannot connect: encrypted relay
relayHint: Requires transport credentials from a free account. The server sees IP addresses and encrypted traffic; it cannot read your files. Never paste admin or API keys.
relayPrivate: It lives only in this session and reaches the iPhone through the private invitation. It is not saved on GitHub.
badRelay: Invalid relay configuration. Paste only the iceServers list with Metered or Cloudflare TURN credentials, never an API key.
relayUnavailable: The relay server did not respond or rejected its credentials. Check validity, quota, and provider ports; no files were sent.
